Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. I checked the code against the current `upstream/main:AGENTS.md` and issue #1889.

The policy reaches the generator, project file, MCP, UI draft, and parameter digest. The refusal occurs before path construction. The tests cover the default, refusal, window selection, undo, saved paths, and unknown policy words. No goldens changed, so there were no moved golden lines to check.

Local validation:

- Reviewed head: `f3c4d3913e0d031dab9748ce58f64da944b177d8`.
- Trial merge with `upstream/main` at `370d38df63bbb7fcacc142f524fcf64c095b5ed2`: already up to date.
- Own worktree: `.claude/worktrees/review-2687`. No GitHub runner was used.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 256 steps, 255 passed, one failed; 27.3 minutes.
- All mapped motion and app suites passed. Motion policy tests: 5 passed. App policy tests: 6 passed. Existing motion Deburr tests: 9 passed.
- Operations: 120 passed, 6 ignored. Project round trips: 73 passed. Deburr links: 1 passed. Deburr alignment: 2 passed. Deburr stock: 5 passed.
- UI library: 1,219 passed, 1 failed, 7 ignored. The new field placement test passed. All mapped UI integration suites passed.
- The UI failure was `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. Its exact rerun failed with the same graphics-adapter error. This is an environment limitation, not a code finding:

```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found
```

- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Release lanes and pixel snapshots were not run.

I repeated two mutations separately in the local review worktree:

1. Disabled the `Refuse` guard in `deburr.rs`. Both refusal tests failed. Restored the guard: all 5 motion policy tests passed.
2. Disabled the policy digest byte in `params/mill3d.rs`. `a_policy_changed_outside_the_edit_command_makes_the_cached_path_stale` failed. Restored the byte: all 6 app policy tests passed.

Both mutations were restored. The worktree has no source changes.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_more_page.rs:225`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for the new Geometry control. The body currently has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body. Do not commit images or review evidence to the PR branch.

The PR is mergeable. Set `needs-rework` for the missing UI evidence. Keep the PR as a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The missing before/after screenshots for the Deburr Geometry control.

The PR body now shows both images. They are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `737640cf4cfab6db0780367bbcbc96b09214b228`.

The images show the real UI with synthetic data. A local CPU renderer draws the egui output. Before capture removes only the new control and hint.

Evidence: `egui_app::tests::every_field_lives_on_exactly_one_section` fails when the control is removed. It passes after restoration.

The quick gate passed all 256 steps. Clippy passed for motion, app, and UI with warnings denied. All temporary source edits are restored.

Head: `f3c4d3913e0d031dab9748ce58f64da944b177d8` (unchanged). The plain push was up to date. No source commit was needed.

Please re-review the screenshots. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f3c4d3913e0d031dab9748ce58f64da944b177d8 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier re-review of the same head. The later `Addressed` comment supplies the evidence requested by the earlier review.

The earlier finding is met. The PR body links before and after screenshots of the Deburr Geometry page. I opened both images. The after image shows `Unreachable edges` with `Skip with note` selected. The images use synthetic data and a CPU renderer, as the body states. They are stored on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The PR changes no image files or capture code.

I checked the source against `upstream/main:AGENTS.md` and issue #1889. The policy reaches generation, the project file, MCP, the UI draft, and the parameter digest. The refusal occurs before path construction. No goldens changed. There were no moved golden lines to check.

Local validation:

- Head: `f3c4d3913e0d031dab9748ce58f64da944b177d8`.
- Trial merge with `upstream/main` at `3a240b7fb2a784037ec951e0b2f2d72ae57acbc6`: clean.
- Worktree: `.claude/worktrees/review-2687`. No GitHub runner was used.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 258 steps, 257 passed, one failed; 28.1 minutes.
- All mapped motion and app suites passed. The motion policy suite passed all 5 tests. The app policy suite passed all 6 tests. The existing motion Deburr suite passed all 9 tests.
- Operations: 120 passed, 6 ignored. Project round trips: 73 passed. Deburr links: 1 passed. Deburr alignment: 2 passed. Deburr stock: 5 passed.
- UI library: 1,232 passed, 1 failed, 7 ignored. `every_field_lives_on_exactly_one_section` passed. All mapped UI integration suites passed.
- The only failure was `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. Its exact local rerun failed with the same graphics-adapter error. This is an environment limitation, not a source finding:

```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found
```

- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Release lanes and pixel snapshots were not run. No pointer test selected the new combo.

I repeated two mutations separately in the review worktree:

1. Disabled the `Refuse` guard in `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/deburr.rs`. Both refusal tests failed. Restored the guard: all 5 motion policy tests passed.
2. Removed the policy digest byte in `crates/app/src/operation/params/mill3d.rs`. `a_policy_changed_outside_the_edit_command_makes_the_cached_path_stale` failed: the status was `Ok`, but the test required `Stale`. Restored the byte: all 6 app policy tests passed.

Both mutations are restored. The worktree has no source changes.

Requested before merge: none. This review replaces the earlier screenshot finding on this head. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`; set `merge-ready` and remove `needs-rework`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
